author: Claude taslak (H-071); kullanıcı onayı bekliyor
notes: Anlatım İngilizcede geniş zamanda (present simple); Türkçede doğal anlatım için çoğunlukla şimdiki zaman (-iyor) kullanıldı.
"window" bu kitapta çoğu zaman pencere önü (pervaz) anlamında: "She sits on your window." = "Senin pencerenin önünde oturuyor."
-s takılı fiillerde (waves, makes, cries) kelime anlamına not düşüldü; "wave" = el sallamak.

lines.en: Omar is new in this city.
It is a very cold city.
There is snow on every street.
But every morning at seven, someone waves.
lines.tr: Ama her sabah saat yedide biri el sallıyor.

lines.en: She lives in the window across the street.

words.across: karşıdaki; karşıya (across the street = sokağın karşısında)

lines.en: But her eyes are not on his face.
She always looks down a little.
He works in a small bread shop.
lines.tr: Küçük bir ekmek dükkânında, bir fırında çalışıyor.

lines.en: The shop is under his flat.
Every day, he makes many kinds of bread.
lines.tr: Her gün birçok çeşit ekmek yapıyor.

lines.en: He also makes his mother's bread.

lines.tr: İnce ve yassı bir ekmek bu.

lines.en: It is the bread of his home.
People come in from the snow.
He does not know many words here.
In the evening, the street is quiet.
So Omar puts a cup of milk outside.
lines.tr: Bu yüzden Omar bir bardak sütü dışarı koyuyor.

lines.en: Every evening, the cup is full.
But every morning, the cup is not full.
lines.tr: Ama her sabah bardak dolu değil.

lines.en: He looks at the snow on the window.
There are small holes in it.
At seven, he goes to the window.
This is the best time of his day.
At night, he practises his words.
But Omar is very, very shy.
lines.tr: Ama Omar çok ama çok utangaç.

lines.en: One night, there is a lot of snow.
Only the bread shop is warm.
In the morning, Omar goes to his window.
There are no holes in the snow.
The girl is at her window.
All day, Omar thinks about the girl.
The shop is very busy today.
There is a small noise behind the bags.
lines.tr: Torbaların arkasında küçük bir ses var.

lines.en: At six o'clock, he closes the shop.
He takes some of his mother's bread.
Then he stops at the door.
Omar goes out into the snow.
The snow is up to his knees.
He stands in front of the girl's door.
But he thinks of her sad face.
She has the same yellow hat.
lines.tr: Onda da aynı sarı şapka var.

lines.en: "Do you have a cat?" asks Freya.

words.call: demek, adını koymak (I call her = ona … diyorum)

lines.en: The little holes in the snow.
"Every morning, I wave to Mimi," says Freya.
lines.tr: "Her sabah Mimi'ye el sallıyorum" diyor Freya.

lines.en: So the hello is for a cat.
lines.tr: Demek ki o merhaba bir kedi içinmiş.

lines.en: "Today there is no Mimi," says Freya.
The small noise behind the bags.
They go to the bread shop together.
The shop is warm and quiet.
He looks behind the bags of flour.
There is a grey and white cat.
Her face is white with flour.
She goes to Freya and sits with her.
lines.tr: Freya'nın yanına gidiyor ve onunla oturuyor.

lines.en: Omar gives Mimi some milk in a bowl.
lines.tr: Omar Mimi'ye bir kasede biraz süt veriyor.

lines.en: Freya gives her a little bread.
lines.tr: Freya da ona biraz ekmek veriyor.

lines.en: "Do you like green tea?" asks Omar.
lines.tr: "Yeşil çay sever misin?" diye soruyor Omar.

lines.en: Now every morning, Mimi sits on Omar's window.
lines.tr: Artık her sabah Mimi Omar'ın penceresinin önünde oturuyor.

lines.en: Omar has three friends in the cold city.
lines.tr: Omar'ın soğuk şehirde üç arkadaşı var.

lines.en: A girl, a mother and a cat.
lines.tr: Bir kız, bir anne ve bir kedi.

phrases.note: Selamlaşma: sabah "Good morning", akşam "Good evening". "Good night" yalnız yatmadan önce, vedalaşırken.
Soru: Do + you + fiil. "Do you like bread?" Cevap: "Yes, I do." / "No, I don't."
"I wave to Mimi." Kime el sallandığı "to" ile söylenir.
"They look like little flowers." = Küçük çiçeklere benziyorlar.
"There is no Mimi today." Türkçede tek kelime "yok".
